versification_crosswalk.final_row_mapping: local 3John.1.14 contains the face-to-face sentence plus peace and friends greetings represented as 3John.1.14-3John.1.15 in the requested strategy route

candidate_units.form: prescript, well-being prayer, visitor testimony, and truth-walking joy report
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: elder/addressee opening and prayer move through the brothers' testimony into the no-greater-joy summary
candidate_units.preference_basis: The prescript and prayer establish the beloved/truth frame; vv3-4 supply its testimony and joy basis; v5 renews direct address for the commendation.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Isolating v2 can create prosperity or health doctrine; splitting vv3-4 detaches testimony from joy; expanding through v5 can obscure the commendation onset; names and family language must not become identity or office evidence.

candidate_units.form: hospitality commendation, assembly testimony, forwarding request, mission rationale, and coworker conclusion
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: faithful work for siblings/strangers receives public testimony, a worthy-sending appeal, because-for-the-Name grounds, and therefore coworker-with-truth conclusion
candidate_units.preference_basis: Commendation, testimony, sending action, mission grounds, and coworker conclusion are mutually explanatory and should remain one case-plus-rationale whole.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Separating vv7-8 from vv5-6 can turn rationale into unrestricted mission/finance doctrine; isolating hospitality actions can create church, money, ethnicity, travel-support, or platform policy.

candidate_units.form: prior-writing report, rejection and action catalogue, and promised recollection
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: prior writing and refusal report lead through malicious speech, non-reception, prevention and expulsion actions to the promised if-I-come response
candidate_units.preference_basis: The named report is incomplete without its causal response and action catalogue; v11 shifts to direct moral exhortation.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Atomizing the catalogue invites office, faction, discipline, personality, or church-history reconstruction; joining v11 can turn a contextual contrast into identification or policy.

candidate_units.form: good-not-evil imitation exhortation and threefold character testimony
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: the imitation and knowing/seeing contrast is immediately followed by testimony from all, truth itself, and the letter's we
candidate_units.preference_basis: The exhortation supplies the moral frame and the testimony supplies its positive exemplar/evidence without requiring identity reconstruction.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Isolating v11 invites assurance or anthropology doctrine; isolating v12 can create a witness hierarchy or identity claim; merging backward can force a factional good/evil identification.

candidate_units.form: writing-medium restraint, face-to-face intention, peace, and reciprocal friends greetings
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: ink-and-pen restraint moves to hoped-for presence and mouth-to-mouth speech, then peace and name-by-name greetings
candidate_units.preference_basis: Media-change intention and peace/friends greetings jointly complete the letter; the local WEB row combines material mapped to requested vv14-15, so no text is invented.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Splitting on edition verse numbering can create a false semantic seam; isolating greetings invites identity, location, network, chronology, or faction reconstruction; medium language must not prove authorship or source.

hardest_seams.why: The well-being prayer and causal joy testimony are distinguishable but share the addressee's flourishing/truth frame; prefer 1-4 and retain 1-2/3-4.
The joy summary closes the opening and renewed beloved address begins the commendation; preserve 1-4/5-8 without making the address alone a seam authority.
The sending appeal receives its because-ground in v7 and therefore-conclusion in v8; reject a split that detaches action from rationale.
The report/action catalogue supplies a negative contrast for the imitation exhortation, but direct address and gnomic form shift; retain 9-10/11-12 and the larger 9-12 alternative.
Requested numbering distinguishes face-to-face intent from peace/friends greetings, while local WEB combines both in v14; preserve 13-15 and record the crosswalk rather than inventing a text seam.

premortem: Do not retain one chapter or split verse by verse; preserve five larger form units unless governed review supplies stronger evidence.

Do not detach prayer from testimony/joy, hospitality commendation from mission rationale, conflict report from action catalogue/response, imitation from testimony, or media-change intention from greetings.
Do not turn internal-Bible parallels into identity, authorship, history, office, faction, policy, source/dependence, canon, doctrine, theology, graph, retrieval, or boundary truth.

Do not let Second Temple, Greco-Roman, later rabbinic, or patristic evidence override the local text or establish setting, identity, office, faction, source, date, policy, canon, doctrine, theology, or seams.

Do not make a prosperity doctrine from v2, mission/finance/ethnicity policy from vv5-8, church-office/faction/discipline history from vv9-10, assurance or witness hierarchy from vv11-12, or identity/network chronology from vv13-15.
Do not treat the local 14-row/requested 15-reference versification difference as missing text or semantic authority; keep the explicit crosswalk and the larger close.
Keep every route LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus; exact alternatives remain live.
